Creates an airtight and watertight seal when joining 110mm PVC-u drainage pipe to clay, asbestos cement and others.  Part of our range of durable and impact resistant fittings for 110mm plastic PVC-u underground drainage pipes, the most common residential system. These lightweight, easy-fit parts are compatible with all systems manufactured to BS EN 1401 or BS EN 13476-2. Pipe and bend fittings are available with pre-chamfered plain or socketed ends, which feature a ring seal for easy and secure connection to different parts of the system. product.name: 5 way 450mm Underground Drainage Base for Inspection Chamber Set Circular Base for Manhole system Base only

The Polydrain MB450 chamber base is a versatile and durable foundation for 450mm inspection chambers, designed specifically for use with 110mm underground drainage systems. Manufactured from tough polypropylene, the MB450 combines strength with lightweight handling, making installation quick and efficient on site.
With a diameter of 450mm and a height of 236mm, the MB450 base provides ample capacity for shallow chamber construction. It features multiple 110mm inlet and outlet positions, supplied with blanking plugs to seal unused connections, giving installers flexibility to adapt layouts to project requirements.
Fully compliant with BS EN 13598-1 and Building Regulations Part H1, the MB450 is suitable for inspection chambers up to 1.2m deep in non-adoptable applications. In Wales, it conforms to SfA7 Type 4 chamber detail, ensuring regional compliance.
The MB450 is compatible with Polydrain risers and a choice of round or square access covers, allowing chambers to be tailored to site conditions and finished neatly at ground level. Its ribbed design ensures stability, while the supplied blanking plugs maintain system integrity.
Trusted by contractors and merchants alike, the Polydrain MB450 chamber base delivers a reliable, regulation-compliant solution for modern drainage systems, balancing ease of installation with long-term performance.

product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Ener-J HygienePro Smart Toilet, an all-in-one design that combines a modern, tankless look with advanced hygiene and comfort technology. The integrated tank removes the need for a separate cistern, giving you a clean, compact profile (680 x 400 x 475 mm) that suits contemporary bathrooms and en-suites. It works with water pressure from just 0.06 MPa, so it performs reliably in most homes.

The built-in bidet heats water instantly as you use it, so there's no waiting and no stored hot water. You can choose from female, hip, massage, moving spray and baby wash modes. Water, seat and dryer temperatures each have four settings (ambient, 34°C, 37°C or 40°C), and the spray position moves forward and backward for a precise, personalised clean. Afterwards, the warm air dryer offers a hands-free, paper-saving finish.

Hygiene is built into every detail. The nozzle cleans itself automatically, UV sterilisation adds extra protection, and the antibacterial seat and anti-fouling ceramic glaze help keep the bowl cleaner for longer. A foam shield reduces splashing, and the dual filtration system protects the water supply.

Control is effortless. You can use voice commands, the included remote, the one-touch side knob or the foot sensors, which open the lid and seat and flush without contact. The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.

product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Ener-J HygienePro Smart Toilet, an all-in-one design that combines a modern, tankless look with advanced hygiene and comfort technology. The integrated tank removes the need for a separate cistern, giving you a clean, compact profile (680 x 400 x 475 mm) that suits contemporary bathrooms and en-suites. It works with water pressure from just 0.06 MPa, so it performs reliably in most homes.

The built-in bidet heats water instantly as you use it, so there's no waiting and no stored hot water. You can choose from female, hip, massage, moving spray and baby wash modes. Water, seat and dryer temperatures each have four settings (ambient, 34°C, 37°C or 40°C), and the spray position moves forward and backward for a precise, personalised clean. Afterwards, the warm air dryer offers a hands-free, paper-saving finish.

Hygiene is built into every detail. The nozzle cleans itself automatically, UV sterilisation adds extra protection, and the antibacterial seat and anti-fouling ceramic glaze help keep the bowl cleaner for longer. A foam shield reduces splashing, and the dual filtration system protects the water supply.

Control is effortless. You can use voice commands, the included remote, the one-touch side knob or the foot sensors, which open the lid and seat and flush without contact. The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.

product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer

The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.
